integrity: Analytic proof and independent supplementary standard-library checks; no independent audit and priority uncertain beyond inspected literature.
scientific_limitations: Only three iid uniform interval nodes, exact quadratic moments, fixed monomial basis and Frobenius norm; no finite-threshold error estimate or oversampled generalization. The measured sensitivity is to perturbations of target moments, not the integrand evaluation data.
title: Sharp moment-sensitivity tails for positive three-node quadratic quadrature
